eval-alerts-bot: :warning: [ALERT] nightly-eval (rw-nightly-v5) — 3 suites failed on quantized candidates. Summary: instruct-robustness dropped 43%->28%, summarization-coherence regression across long-doc prompts, api-fewshot median ROUGE down 7pts. Link: https://ci.redwood/evals/1769456789 :eyes:

marcus: seeing this now. initial severity P2? can we get quick repro and which model variants are impacted (int4 vs int8 vs fp16)?

ritika: assigned to me. will run localized evals on the three failing suites. first pass: suspect int4 path for rw-v5-7b-q4.

anya: quick note — nightly changed rollout yesterday to prefer q4 for cost testing. might be correlated.

marcus: good catch @anya. @ritika please include the baseline (fp16) outputs. emphasis on failing prompts from instruct-robustness set.

ritika: doing that. running: ```rwinfer eval-run --suite instruct-robustness,summarization-coherence,api-fewshot --models rw-v5-7b-fp16,rw-v5-7b-q4 --since 24h --save-outputs /tmp/eval-1769``` will paste diffs in a bit.

build-bot: Started job 1769456791: runner=ml-eval-12, docker=rw-eval:2026-03-20, node=gpu-07

ritika: quick log snippet from q4 run (trimmed): ```ERROR: sample mismatch on prompt id 4821: expected "Yes, do X" got "I'm not sure" -- coherence drop noted```

anya: that prompt id is in the few-shot anchor set used for regression detection. if q4 changes sampling distribution, we should see token-level probs differ. can you dump token log for that id?

ritika: will do. also seeing higher repetition in long-doc summarization outputs, likely early-loop attention kernel fallback for q4 under long sequence lengths.

marcus: ok action plan from initial look: (1) @ritika reproduce and attach per-prompt diffs + token logs; (2) @anya check deployment/rollout change that flipped q4 as default yesterday and roll it back if needed for hosted tests; (3) run quick A/B between q4 and fp16 on a 500-sample smoke set to measure p95 latency vs quality delta; (4) set eval-alerts-bot severity to P1 only if fp16 also regresses.

ritika: ETA 60-90m for reproducible artifacts. posting candidate blame matrix once done.

anya: I'll check infra config now — pinging infra eng if rollback needed. @marcus do you want me to hold Dedicated traffic?

marcus: not yet. prefer targeted rollback for nightly evals + disable q4 experiment flag for the eval cohort. no customer-facing changes until we confirm.

ritika: uploaded diffs: https://ci.redwood/evals/1769456789/diffs.tar.gz — highlights: instruct-robustness fails concentrated on instruction-following prompts with contrastive phrasing; api-fewshot loss increased on math-like tasks.

anya: infra note: experiment flag `enable_q4_default` was flipped 16 hours ago. reverting for nightly-eval group now. rollback started. build-bot shows config update in progress.

build-bot: Config update applied to eval cluster: enable_q4_default=false (commit 7f3a2c)

ritika: re-ran instruct-robustness on reverted config: q4-disabled fp16 baseline looks back to prior numbers: 42% -> 41% (within noise). q4 still shows 27-29%. attaching token diff for sample 4821: ```- token probs fp16: [0.32,0.28,0.12,...] + token probs q4: [0.18,0.22,0.30,...]```

marcus: that nails it — quantization artifact. severity remains P2 for now. next: open issue to track quantization regression for rw-v5-7b-q4, include reproducer and sample set. owners: @ritika (reproducer + evals), @anya (rollout/flags), eng-runtime on-call (cc).

ritika: creating GH issue now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/4123 — title "rw-v5-7b-q4: nightly eval quality regression (instruct/summarization)". will attach diffs and suggested bisect range.

anya: tagging eng-runtime and quant team. pinged @quant-team in the issue.

marcus: thanks everyone. follow-ups: (a) schedule a short post-mortem if this persists after bisect; (b) temporary guardrails: don't auto-promote q4 variants to nightly evaluation cohort until a fix validated. I'll update the rollout playbook.

ritika: noted. I'll drop a summary in the incident channel once we have the bisect results.

eval-alerts-bot: :white_check_mark: nightly-eval re-run complete for fp16 cohort, status stable. q4 flagged in issues list.
